title: zoho.com/cliq/pricing.md
snippet:
## Plans
### Free
- Messaging and channels
- File storage
- Meetings with screen share
- Remote work
- Chat export
### Standard
Everything in the Free edition, plus:
- External channels
- Call recording
- Custom domain and email
- Basic usage reports
- Networks (Add-on)
### Professional
Everything in the Standard edition, plus:
- Team management
- Task management
- Roles and permissions
- Module configurations
- Live events and room devices
- Mobile permissions
- Networks (3 free Networks)
- Bulk team import (New)
- IP restriction across clients (New)
- On-demand chat summary (New)
### Enterprise
Everything in the Professional edition, plus:
- Audit history
- Advanced usage reports
- eDiscovery and DRP
- Networks (3 free Networks)
- Data Loss Prevention (DLP) (New)
- Branded meetings (New)
- Usage report export (New)

| Plan | Monthly Billing | Annual Billing |
|---|---|---|
| Free | Free | Free |
| Standard | US$18/month (up to 25 users) | US$16.20/month (up to 25 users) |
| Professional | US$2/user/month | US$1.80/user/month |
| Enterprise | US$4/user/month | US$3.60/user/month |
